rules.title: San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance (affordable housing)
rules.requirement: In San Francisco affordable housing decisions, residents and applicants with an arrest or conviction history are protected under the Fair Chance Ordinance. The page gives no further detail on the specific limits.
rules.key_value: protection for arrest/conviction history in affordable housing decisions
rules.quoted_span: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions.
rules.effective_date_note: Document does not state an effective date.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to affordable housing decisions only, per the page.

requires_unknown_facts: unit is in an affordable housing project

parsed.doc_summary: SF Human Rights Commission homepage. The only housing-law content is a one-line link blurb saying the Fair Chance Ordinance protects people with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions. The rest is events, news and contact information.
